title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Access Features and Daily Outflow Limits
content:
The ways money can leave a Savings & Money Market Accounts product differ by tier. This matrix records, for each tier, whether it can back a checking account as its overdraft protection source, whether money market checks may be written on it, whether an ATM card reaches it, and the daily caps on ATM cash and on transfers out through online or mobile banking.

## Capability matrix

| Tier | May serve as a checking account's overdraft protection source | Money market checks | ATM card access | ATM cash per calendar day, at most (USD) | Online or mobile transfers out per calendar day, at most (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | yes | no | yes | 500.00 | 5000.00 |
| Statement Savings | yes | no | yes | 500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | no | no | no | 0.00 | 5000.00 |
| Money Market Account | yes | yes | yes | 800.00 | 25000.00 |
| Premier Money Market | yes | yes | yes | 1000.00 | 50000.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | yes | yes | yes | 2500.00 | 250000.00 |

## Reading the matrix

- An ATM limit of 0.00 goes with a tier that has no ATM access at all.
- The transfer cap covers value sent out through online banking or the mobile app in one calendar day.
- Check writing is a money market feature; none of the three savings tiers offers it.

## Worked comparisons (hypothetical requests)

**A Statement Savings owner wants 600.00 in ATM cash today.** That exceeds the tier's 500.00 daily ATM figure.

**A Premier Money Market owner sends 30000.00 online in one day.** That sits within the tier's 50000.00 daily transfer figure.

**Can Goal Builder Savings be linked to protect a checking account from overdrafts?** No; it is the one tier marked ineligible.
